scenes.text: Your first hundred videos aren't content. They're tuition.
scenes.title: 100 VIDEOS

scenes.text: Most people think every video has to work.
So they post one, it gets two hundred views, and they decide they're just not built for this.
scenes.title: VIDEO 1

scenes.text: But imagine someone who posts every single day for three months.
Video one gets forty views. Video thirty gets five hundred. Video sixty-two suddenly gets two hundred thousand... and everyone calls it luck.
Here's what nobody sees. By video sixty-two, she knows which first second makes people stop.
She knows which topics her audience saves, and which ones they skip. She can film, edit and post in twenty minutes, while everyone else is still choosing a font.
scenes.title: BY VIDEO 62

scenes.text: That's not luck. That's what the first sixty-one videos were paying for.
This happens because skill doesn't show up in the result you're getting today. It shows up later, all at once, and only for the people who kept paying.
So stop asking whether this video will go viral. Ask whether you'll still be here for the one that does.
scenes.title: STILL BE HERE?
